g.text: Is each top pair at or above its positive control?

Signed difference with a bootstrap 95% CI (2,000 gene resamples); the shaded half-plane is "at or above". Both panels plot an r difference — panel b ranks pairs by ΔJ but the control comparison is only defined on the correlation.
colour = condition marker = quality of the control denominator
